```{=html}
  <h1>From fields<br><span class="ln2">to markets.</span></h1>
```

## Methods & tools {#methods}

```{=html}
<div class="msm-cards">
  <div class="msm-card">
    <span class="ico"><i class="fa-solid fa-seedling" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
    <h3>Modelling frameworks</h3>
    <ul class="msm-refs">
      <li><a href="https://www.simplace.net/">SIMPLACE</a> — Scientific Impact Assessment and Modelling Platform for Advanced Crop and Ecosystem Management</li>
      <li><a href="http://www.biomamodelling.org/">BioMA</a> — Biophysical Models Applications framework, from prototype to operational applications</li>
      <li><a href="https://marswiki.jrc.ec.europa.eu/agri4castwiki/index.php/Welcome_to_WikiMCYFS">MCYFS</a> — MARS Crop Yield Forecasting System for crop monitoring and yield forecasting</li>
      <li>Our own open-source packages <a href="tools.html#geeagri">geeagri</a> and <a href="tools.html#torchcrop">torchcrop</a> — see <a href="tools.html">Tools</a></li>
    </ul>

    <ul class="msm-refs">
      <li>Ensemble learning, convolutional neural networks and foundation models</li>
      <li>Hybrid process-based + ML modelling</li>
      <li>Explainable AI (XAI)</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
  <div class="msm-card">
    <span class="ico"><i class="fa-solid fa-earth-europe" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>

      <li>Multi-model ensembles (AgMIP)</li>
```

## Scientific contributions {#contributions}

::: {.msm-prose}
Since joining ZALF, group members have published peer-reviewed work on crop and cropping-system modelling, climate-impact assessment, hybrid modelling and Earth observation, including large international model-intercomparison studies.
